name: 75052 · Grand Prairie, TX
findings: ZIP 75052 (Grand Prairie) has 244 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75052 (Grand Prairie) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
